One Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. One Capital Management Llc sold 3,706 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 34,608 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.86M, down from 38,314 at the end of the previous reported quarter. One Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $924.08B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.19% or $0.35 $188.01. About 18.06M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
